name: Triple confluence on the SOL/AVAX/LINK high-beta sleeve: fear + VIX + funding flush
rationale: Thesis: the SAME stress triple (fear_greed extreme-low + vix_level elevated + funding_rate flushed) should pay MORE on the high-beta alt sleeve (SOL/AVAX/LINK/ADA-type names) because these overshoot to the downside during cross-market panic and snap back harder — the capitulation premium scales with beta. We keep a stricter min_liquidity so only the tradeable high-beta names qualify. All three axes are bounded levels. Long-only spot, medium hold. Disconfirmer: run the IDENTICAL triple on the BTC/ETH large-cap sleeve; this high-beta version must beat large-caps on deflated Sharpe net of the SAME fees. If large-caps match or beat, the high-beta sleeve is just leverage on one signal (more vol, not more edge) and adds nothing. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: cross-market stress triple hitting the high-beta alt sleeve
